title.es: Insistir, escalar y cerrar el asunto

es: Reconocer las jugadas de un hilo de correos de reclamación: recordar (chase), escalar, confirmar y cerrar (close the loop).

vocabulary.es: escalar, subir a un nivel superior
cerrar el asunto e informar del final

teaching.en: I am writing to chase my order; I have not had a reply.
teaching.es: Escribo para reclamar mi pedido; no he recibido respuesta.
teaching.explanationEs: Chase: recuerdas algo pendiente. Es la primera jugada de un hilo sin respuesta.
segments: I am writing to chase my order;
I have not had a reply.
teaching.audioText: I am writing to chase my order; I have not had a reply.

teaching.en: This is a reminder that the repair is still unresolved.
teaching.es: Este es un recordatorio de que la reparación sigue sin resolverse.
teaching.explanationEs: Reminder e unresolved suelen ir juntos en un segundo correo.
segments: This is a reminder that
the repair is still unresolved.
teaching.audioText: This is a reminder that the repair is still unresolved.

teaching.en: If the matter is not solved by Friday, I will escalate it to your manager.
teaching.es: Si el asunto no se resuelve para el viernes, lo escalaré a su gerente.
teaching.explanationEs: Escalate + objeto + to + persona: subes el asunto a alguien con más autoridad.
segments: If the matter is not solved by Friday,
I will escalate it to your manager.
teaching.audioText: If the matter is not solved by Friday, I will escalate it to your manager.

teaching.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
teaching.es: Por favor, acuse recibo de este correo.
teaching.explanationEs: Acknowledge receipt pide una confirmación breve de que el mensaje llegó.
segments: Please acknowledge receipt
of this email.
teaching.audioText: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.

teaching.en: Just to close the loop, the matter is now solved.
teaching.es: Solo para cerrar el tema: el asunto ya está resuelto.
teaching.explanationEs: Close the loop: avisas del final a quien siguió el caso; el hilo termina.
segments: Just to close the loop,
the matter is now solved.
teaching.audioText: Just to close the loop, the matter is now solved.

teaching.en: I am writing to follow up on my email of Tuesday; it is still unresolved.
teaching.es: Escribo para dar seguimiento a mi correo del martes; sigue sin resolverse.
teaching.explanationEs: To follow up on + correo: fórmula estándar para recordar con cortesía.
segments: I am writing to follow up on my
email of Tuesday; it is still unresolved.
teaching.audioText: I am writing to follow up on my email of Tuesday; it is still unresolved.

prompt.es: Clasifica el correo: ¿qué jugada hace en el hilo?

choices.text: It escalates the matter.
It chases an earlier message.
It closes the matter.

feedback.es: El correo recuerda un mensaje anterior que no ha tenido respuesta: es una jugada de recordatorio (chase), sin amenaza ni cierre.

hint.es: Busca qué recuerda el escritor y qué todavía falta.

origin.text: I am writing to follow up on my email of 3 May. I have not yet received a reply.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no hay respuesta, lo escalaré a su gerente.»

feedback.es: Escalate this to + persona es la fórmula para subir el asunto a alguien con más autoridad.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa «subir el asunto a un nivel superior».

origin.text: If I hear nothing, I will ___ this to your manager.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Escribo para dar seguimiento a mi correo del lunes.»

answer.text: I am writing to follow up on my email of Monday

feedback.es: I am writing to follow up on + correo es la fórmula estándar de recordatorio cortés.

hint.es: Empieza por I am writing y usa to + verbo para el propósito.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase del hilo con su jugada.

pairs: I have copied my manager on this message.
Thank you for confirming the new date.
This is a second reminder about my refund.
The heater works now, so the matter is closed.

feedback.es: Copiar al gerente escala; agradecer una fecha confirma; un segundo recordatorio chase y informar de que todo funciona cierra el asunto.

pairs: I have copied my manager on this message.
Thank you for confirming the new date.
This is a second reminder about my refund.
The heater works now, so the matter is closed.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige qué jugada hace el cliente.

choices.text: He confirms the repair date.
He thanks the company and closes the matter.
He chases and warns that he may escalate.

feedback.es: Tom recuerda que no ha tenido respuesta (chase) y avisa de que hablará con el gerente si no hay noticias el viernes.

origin.audio: Hello, this is Tom Ruiz. I wrote to you twice about my broken heater and I have had no answer. If I do not hear from you by Friday, I will speak to your manager.

prompt.es: Completa: «Por favor, acuse recibo de este mensaje.»

feedback.es: Acknowledge receipt es la fórmula para pedir que confirmen que recibieron el mensaje.

origin.text: Please ___ receipt of this message.

prompt.es: ¿Qué jugada hace este correo en el hilo de reclamación?

choices.text: It confirms an arrangement.
It escalates the matter.
It chases a reply.

feedback.es: La escritora agradece la confirmación de la cita y acepta la hora: es una jugada de confirmación, no de insistencia ni de escalada.

origin.text: Hi Sara, thanks for confirming the new appointment for Monday at nine. I will be at home. Kind regards, Tom

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje y elige su jugada en el hilo.

choices.text: The writer thanks the company for the repair.
The writer asks a manager to take over the problem.
The writer asks for a cheaper repair.

feedback.es: Al poner en copia a la directora y esperar una llamada, el cliente sube el caso a una persona con más autoridad: es una escalada.

origin.audio: I am copying the director of customer service because the repair is still unresolved after three weeks. I expect a call today.

prompt.es: ¿Con qué jugada termina este correo el hilo?

choices.text: It chases an unanswered message.
It escalates to a manager.
It closes the matter and reports the result.

feedback.es: El correo informa de que el calentador ya funciona y agradece la ayuda: cierra el asunto (close the loop).

origin.text: Just to close the loop: the engineer came yesterday and the heater works perfectly now. Thank you for your help.

prompt.es: Completa: «Este es un recordatorio: mi reembolso sigue sin resolverse.»

feedback.es: Reminder es el sustantivo de la jugada de recordatorio; unresolved explica por qué insiste.

origin.text: This is a ___: my refund is still unresolved.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que recuerda algo pendiente sin agresividad.

choices.text: I am writing to follow up on my refund.
Why do you never answer?
I will escalate this to your boss.

feedback.es: To follow up on recuerda el tema con cortesía; las otras opciones reprochan o suben el tono antes de tiempo.

origin.text: Esperas un reembolso desde hace diez días y quieres recordarlo con cortesía.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace la empresa en este mensaje.

choices.text: It closes the matter for ever.
It acknowledges the complaint and gives a date.
It refuses to send an engineer.

feedback.es: La empresa acusa recibo de la queja y da una fecha de visita; aún no cierra el asunto.

origin.audio: Thank you for your email. We acknowledge your complaint, and the engineer will visit on Thursday morning.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Solo para cerrar el tema: ya está resuelto.»

answer.text: Just to close the loop the matter is solved

feedback.es: Just to close the loop avisa del final a quien siguió el caso; el asunto ya está resuelto.

es: Redactar recordatorios y reclamos firmes pero corteses con fórmulas de seguimiento y suavizadores escritos; repaso del causativo have + objeto + participio.

teaching.en: I am just following up on my request. Could you kindly send me an update?
teaching.es: Solo quería dar seguimiento a mi solicitud. ¿Podría enviarme amablemente una novedad?
teaching.explanationEs: Just suaviza el recordatorio y kindly suaviza la petición; siguen pidiendo algo concreto.
segments: I am just following up on my request.
Could you kindly send me an update?
teaching.audioText: I am just following up on my request. Could you kindly send me an update?

teaching.en: I am afraid I have not yet received the part.
teaching.es: Me temo que todavía no he recibido la pieza.
teaching.explanationEs: I am afraid suaviza una mala noticia o una queja sin perder el mensaje.
segments: I am afraid I have
not yet received the part.
teaching.audioText: I am afraid I have not yet received the part.

teaching.en: I would be grateful if you could confirm the date by Friday.
teaching.es: Le agradecería que pudiera confirmar la fecha antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: I would be grateful if you could + verbo + plazo: firme y cortés a la vez.
segments: I would be grateful if you
could confirm the date by Friday.
teaching.audioText: I would be grateful if you could confirm the date by Friday.

teaching.en: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case by Monday.
teaching.es: Por favor, responda en cuanto le sea posible y, en todo caso, antes del lunes.
teaching.explanationEs: At your earliest convenience es suave; el plazo (by Monday) mantiene la firmeza.
segments: Please reply at your earliest convenience,
and in any case by Monday.
teaching.audioText: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case by Monday.

teaching.en: We would be grateful to have the heater repaired by Friday.
teaching.es: Le agradeceríamos que el calentador estuviera reparado para el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Have + objeto + participio: pides que otra persona lo haga (causativo).
segments: We would be grateful to have
the heater repaired by Friday.
teaching.audioText: We would be grateful to have the heater repaired by Friday.

teaching.en: I understand the delay, but I must remain firm about Friday.
teaching.es: Entiendo el retraso, pero debo mantenerme firme con el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Comprender y mantenerse firme van juntos: el tono baja, el plazo no.
segments: I understand the delay, but I
must remain firm about Friday.
teaching.audioText: I understand the delay, but I must remain firm about Friday.

prompt.es: Elige la versión firme pero cortés de esta frase brusca.

choices.text: Reply whenever you like.
You must answer me now, or else.
I would be grateful if you could reply today.

feedback.es: I would be grateful if you could reply today mantiene la urgencia (today) con una fórmula cortés; reply whenever you like pierde firmeza y or else pierde cortesía.

hint.es: La buena versión mantiene la urgencia y baja el tono.

origin.text: Answer me now.

prompt.es: Completa: «Le agradecería que pudiera confirmar la fecha.»

feedback.es: I would be grateful if you could + verbo es la fórmula firme y cortés para pedir algo.

hint.es: Es el adjetivo de la gratitud.

origin.text: I would be ___ if you could confirm the date.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me gustaría que el coche estuviera reparado para el viernes.»

answer.text: I would like to have the car repaired by Friday

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (have the car repaired) pide que otra persona lo arregle; by Friday mantiene el plazo.

hint.es: Usa have + el coche + el participio de repair.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase brusca con la fórmula que la mejora.

pairs: You are late.
Fix it by Friday.
Tell me the date.
Answer me now.

pairs.es: pedir con I would be grateful if…

feedback.es: Cada frase brusca mejora con una fórmula distinta, y en todas se conserva el dato duro (fecha o petición).

pairs: You are late.
Fix it by Friday.
Tell me the date.
Answer me now.

pairs.es: pedir con I would be grateful if…

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje y elige cómo se mantiene firme el hablante.

choices.text: He stays polite but keeps the Friday deadline.
He cancels the repair because of the delay.
He agrees to wait as long as necessary.

feedback.es: El hablante comprende el retraso pero mantiene el plazo del viernes con I am afraid: firme y cortés.

origin.audio: I understand that parts can be late. I am afraid I must remain firm: I need the heater repaired by Friday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Por favor, envíe la factura en cuanto le sea posible.»

feedback.es: At your earliest convenience es una fórmula suave para pedir respuesta pronto.

origin.text: Please send the invoice at your earliest ___.

prompt.es: Elige la mejor reescritura de esta frase brusca de un correo.

choices.text: I do not care if the part is late.
I am afraid the part has not arrived yet.
You never send the part on time.

feedback.es: I am afraid da la queja con suavidad y mantiene el hecho (la pieza no ha llegado); las otras opciones son indiferentes o acusadoras.

origin.text: You are always late with the part.

prompt.es: Completa: «¿Podría confirmar amablemente la fecha?»

feedback.es: Kindly suaviza la petición dentro de Could you…? sin quitar el dato que se pide.

origin.text: Could you ___ confirm the date?

prompt.es: Reescribe con firmeza y cortesía: pide la pieza antes del viernes.

answer.text: I would be grateful if you could send me the part by Friday. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
accepted: I would be grateful if you could send me the part by Friday. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
Could you kindly send me the part by Friday? I would appreciate an update, and I look forward to your reply.

feedback.es: Una buena reescritura mantiene el plazo (by Friday), cambia la orden por una fórmula cortés y cierra con seguimiento.

origin.text: Frase brusca de un correo: «Send me the part now or I will complain.» Reescríbela en inglés con firmeza y cortesía: pide la pieza para el viernes y cierra con una fórmula de seguimiento (de 12 a 35 palabras).

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me temo que todavía no he recibido la factura.»

answer.text: I am afraid I have not yet received the invoice

choices.text: I would like to repair the heater.
I would like the heater repairing.
I would like to have the heater repaired.

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (have the heater repaired) indica que lo hará otro; to repair sería hacerlo uno mismo.

origin.text: Tú no vas a reparar nada: quieres que lo haga un técnico.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje y elige cómo suena el recordatorio de la clienta.

choices.text: A polite reminder that asks for a date.
A rude complaint with a threat.
A thank-you message that closes the matter.

feedback.es: I am just following up y could you kindly dan un recordatorio cortés que pide una fecha concreta.

origin.audio: Hello, I am just following up on my request. Could you kindly let me know when the engineer can come?

feedback.es: I look forward to + -ing es la fórmula de cierre: espero con interés tu respuesta.

origin.text: I look ___ to hearing from you before Monday.

title.es: Leer una cadena de correos de servicio

es: Comprender una cadena de tres correos sobre una reparación y localizar el problema, el plazo y la solución acordada.

teaching.en: The washing machine has a leak, and the kitchen floor is wet.
teaching.es: La lavadora tiene una fuga y el suelo de la cocina está mojado.
teaching.explanationEs: Primer dato de un hilo: el problema (qué falla).
segments: The washing machine has a leak,
and the kitchen floor is wet.
teaching.audioText: The washing machine has a leak, and the kitchen floor is wet.

teaching.en: An engineer can visit on Monday morning.
teaching.es: Un técnico puede visitarnos el lunes por la mañana.
teaching.explanationEs: El plazo suele ser un día o un tiempo: visit on + día.
segments: An engineer can visit
on Monday morning.
teaching.audioText: An engineer can visit on Monday morning.

teaching.en: The spare part takes a week to arrive by post.
teaching.es: La pieza de repuesto tarda una semana en llegar por correo.
teaching.explanationEs: Takes + tiempo + to + verbo: «tarda … en llegar».
segments: The spare part takes a
week to arrive by post.
teaching.audioText: The spare part takes a week to arrive by post.

teaching.en: As agreed, the company will send the part by courier.
teaching.es: Como se acordó, la empresa enviará la pieza por mensajero.
teaching.explanationEs: As agreed anuncia la solución acordada: quién hace qué.
segments: As agreed, the company will
send the part by courier.
teaching.audioText: As agreed, the company will send the part by courier.

teaching.en: The repair is free of charge because of the warranty.
teaching.es: La reparación es gratuita por la garantía.
teaching.explanationEs: Free of charge = sin coste; because of + nombre da el motivo.
segments: The repair is free of
charge because of the warranty.
teaching.audioText: The repair is free of charge because of the warranty.

teaching.en: The customer describes the leak, the company offers a visit, and they agree a solution.
teaching.es: El cliente describe la fuga, la empresa ofrece una visita y acuerdan una solución.
teaching.explanationEs: Orden típico de un hilo: problema, plazo y solución.
segments: The customer describes the leak, the company offers
a visit, and they agree a solution.
teaching.audioText: The customer describes the leak, the company offers a visit, and they agree a solution.

prompt.es: Lee el primer correo y elige cuál es el problema.

choices.text: The washing machine leaks water onto the floor.
The washing machine does not turn on.
The washing machine is too noisy at night.

feedback.es: Tom escribe «is leaking water onto the kitchen floor»: el problema es una fuga, no un fallo de encendido ni ruido.

hint.es: Busca lo que sale de la máquina y dónde cae.

origin.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
My washing machine is leaking water onto the kitchen floor. I bought it from your shop in March. Could you send an engineer?
Kind regards,
Tom Ruiz

prompt.es: Completa el resumen con el día que propone Sam.

feedback.es: Sam escribe «An engineer can visit on Monday»: el lunes es el plazo de la visita.

hint.es: Busca un día de la semana en el correo de Sam.

origin.text:
Dear Mr Ruiz,
I am sorry to hear that. An engineer can visit on Monday, but the spare part takes a week to arrive by post.
Kind regards,
Sam
Summary: The engineer can visit on ___.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El técnico llegará el martes por la tarde.»

answer.text: The engineer will arrive on Tuesday afternoon

feedback.es: Con un día se usa on (on Tuesday) y afternoon cierra el momento de la visita.

hint.es: Con los días de la semana se usa on.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fragmento del hilo con el dato que aporta.

pairs: The fridge stopped working on Sunday.
The part will arrive by next Thursday.
As agreed, the shop will replace the screen.
I am sorry for the delay.

feedback.es: Cada fragmento aporta un dato distinto: lo que falla, cuándo llega, lo acordado o solo una disculpa.

pairs: The fridge stopped working on Sunday.
The part will arrive by next Thursday.
As agreed, the shop will replace the screen.
I am sorry for the delay.

prompt.es: Escucha el correo y elige la solución que propone la empresa.

choices.text: They repair the old phone in the shop next week.
They send a new phone tomorrow and take back the old one.
They refund the price and keep the old phone.

feedback.es: La empresa ofrece enviar un teléfono nuevo mañana y recoger el viejo en la misma caja; es la solución que propone.

origin.audio: Dear Ms Lopez, thank you for your patience. We can send a new phone tomorrow, and you can return the old one in the same box. This is free of charge.

prompt.es: Completa el resumen con lo que acuerdan en el último correo.

feedback.es: Tom resume lo acordado por teléfono: «you will order the part today by courier».

origin.text:
Dear Sam,
A week is too long for my family. As we agreed on the phone, you will order the part today by courier, and the engineer will bring it with him. Please confirm.
Kind regards,
Tom
Summary: The shop will order the part by ___.

prompt.es: Según el correo, ¿qué plazo da la empresa?

choices.text: Tuesday after lunch.
Next month.
Thursday before noon.

feedback.es: La empresa promete la entrega «on Thursday before noon»; las otras opciones son plazos que el correo no menciona.

origin.text: Dear Ms Ortiz, your parcel was delayed at the airport. It will arrive on Thursday before noon. If it does not, call us and we will send another one. Kind regards, Dan

prompt.es: Escucha el correo y elige el problema que describe la clienta.

choices.text: Two keys on the keyboard do not work.
The keyboard arrived broken in the box.
The keyboard is too expensive for her.

feedback.es: La clienta dice que dos teclas no funcionan y que cambiar el cable no ayuda: ese es el problema.

origin.audio: Dear Sir, the keyboard I bought last month has two keys that do not work. I have tried a new cable, but nothing changes. Could you please help?

prompt.es: Según el correo, ¿qué solución acuerdan el cliente y la tienda?

choices.text: The customer repairs the fridge and the shop pays later.
The shop takes the broken fridge and brings a new one free of charge.
The customer returns the fridge and gets no replacement.

feedback.es: As agreed anuncia la solución: recogen el frigorífico roto y traen uno nuevo sin coste por la garantía.

origin.text: Dear Mr Silva, as agreed on the phone, we will collect the broken fridge on Wednesday and bring a new one on Saturday. There is no charge because of the warranty. Best wishes, Olga

prompt.es: Completa el mapa con los datos del hilo de correos.

feedback.es: El hilo da el problema (se corta cada tarde), el plazo (el técnico llama el miércoles por la tarde) y la solución (cambiar el router si sigue el fallo).

sentences: Deadline: a technician calls on ___ afternoon.
Solution: the company will replace the ___ if it continues.
origin.text:
Email 1 (Carlos): Dear FastNet, my internet has stopped every evening for ten days. I work from home, so I need it fixed soon. Kind regards, Carlos Vega
Email 2 (Jana): Dear Mr Vega, we are sorry. A technician will call on Wednesday afternoon. If the problem continues, we will replace the router on Friday. Regards, Jana
Email 3 (Carlos): Dear Jana, thank you. As agreed, I will stay at home on Wednesday afternoon, and you will replace the router on Friday if the problem continues. Please confirm. Carlos

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje y elige cuándo puede ir la técnica.

choices.text: On Thursday at noon.
Whenever the customer calls.
On Friday morning.

feedback.es: La técnica puede visitar el viernes a las diez, es decir, por la mañana; no se habla del jueves.

origin.audio: Hello Mr Lee, the technician can visit on Friday at ten, but she needs someone at home. Please call us if that is not possible.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase indica que la solución ya está acordada?

choices.text: As agreed, the company will refund the fee.
The company might refund the fee.
Could the company refund the fee?

feedback.es: As agreed + will indica un acuerdo cerrado; might y la pregunta solo expresan posibilidad.

origin.text: Quieres dejar claro en tu correo que la empresa ya aceptó devolver la tarifa.

prompt.es: Completa: «Esta reparación es gratuita porque la máquina tiene garantía.»

feedback.es: Free of charge es la expresión fija para «gratis, sin coste».

origin.text: This repair is free of ___ because the machine has a warranty.

title.en: Write a clear request or complaint
title.es: Redactar una petición o reclamo claro

es: Redactar un correo de reclamo a un servicio técnico que no respondió antes: referencia, problema, petición con plazo, consecuencia y cierre, con firmeza y cortesía.

teaching.en: I am writing again because I have not received a reply to my previous email.
teaching.es: Escribo de nuevo porque no he recibido respuesta a mi correo anterior.
teaching.explanationEs: Previous email recuerda el primer mensaje: es la referencia del segundo correo.
segments: I am writing again because I have not
received a reply to my previous email.
teaching.audioText: I am writing again because I have not received a reply to my previous email.

teaching.en: This delay is unacceptable, as the heater has been broken for three weeks.
teaching.es: Este retraso es inaceptable, ya que el calentador lleva tres semanas estropeado.
teaching.explanationEs: Unacceptable da firmeza; el hecho con su fecha la justifica.
segments: This delay is unacceptable, as the heater
has been broken for three weeks.
teaching.audioText: This delay is unacceptable, as the heater has been broken for three weeks.

teaching.en: I apologise for any inconvenience, but I need this resolved by Friday.
teaching.es: Pido disculpas por cualquier molestia, pero necesito que esto esté resuelto para el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Apologise for any inconvenience suaviza; by Friday mantiene el plazo.
segments: I apologise for any inconvenience, but
I need this resolved by Friday.
teaching.audioText: I apologise for any inconvenience, but I need this resolved by Friday.

teaching.en: Please resolve the problem promptly and confirm the date of the visit.
teaching.es: Por favor, resuelva el problema con prontitud y confirme la fecha de la visita.
teaching.explanationEs: Resolve + promptly: petición directa y cortés con please.
segments: Please resolve the problem promptly and
confirm the date of the visit.
teaching.audioText: Please resolve the problem promptly and confirm the date of the visit.

teaching.en: Failing that, I will make a formal complaint.
teaching.es: De lo contrario, presentaré una queja formal.
teaching.explanationEs: Failing that anuncia la consecuencia con cortesía, sin amenazas.
segments: Failing that, I will
make a formal complaint.
teaching.audioText: Failing that, I will make a formal complaint.

teaching.en: I trust that you will understand my concern.
teaching.es: Confío en que comprenderá mi preocupación.
teaching.explanationEs: I trust that cierra el correo con expectativa de respuesta.
segments: I trust that you
will understand my concern.
teaching.audioText: I trust that you will understand my concern.

prompt.es: Elige cómo empezar un segundo correo que recuerda el primero sin respuesta.

choices.text: I am writing to say hello again.
I am writing again regarding my previous message.
I never wrote to you before.

feedback.es: Regarding my previous message da la referencia: recuerda el primer mensaje sin respuesta; las otras opciones no lo mencionan.

hint.es: Empieza por recordar el mensaje anterior.

prompt.es: Completa: «El servicio fue inaceptable, por eso escribo de nuevo.»

feedback.es: Unacceptable es el adjetivo firme para calificar un retraso sin insultar.

answer.text: Dear Ms Gil, I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June, which has not received a reply. The heating in my flat has not worked for three weeks. The flat is cold, and I have two young children, so this situation is very difficult for my family. I apologise for any inconvenience to you, but I am afraid this delay is unacceptable. I would be grateful if you could send an engineer by Friday 13 June, and I would like to have the heater repaired on the same visit. Please confirm the date of the visit promptly by email or by phone. I have attached a copy of my previous email so that you can see the details. Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to your manager. I trust that we can resolve this matter quickly. Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Leo Vega

Dear Ms Gil, I wrote to you on 2 June about the heating in my flat, but I have not had an answer. The heater has been broken for three weeks, and my two children are cold every night. I understand that you are busy, but I must remain firm: this situation is unacceptable. Could you kindly send an engineer before Friday 13 June? We are using two small electric heaters, and our electricity bill is already higher. I would also like to have the heater repaired during that visit, so that I do not need to ask again. Please confirm the date promptly. Failing that, I will make a formal complaint, and I will escalate the matter to your manager. answer.text: Dear Ms Lee, thank you for your reply and for your counteroffer. I appreciate that you have looked at my case. I am afraid I must decline both options as they stand. A refund of half the price would not cover a new laptop, and a repair in three weeks is too long, because I need the laptop for my work. However, I would like to propose a compromise. I am willing to settle for the repair, on the condition that it is finished by Friday 27 June and that you lend me another laptop until then. In addition, I would be grateful for a discount on the repair, as the delay has caused me a lot of inconvenience. I understand that this may be difficult, so I am happy to meet you halfway on the discount. Please confirm your decision by Monday, and I will consider the matter closed once the laptop is back with me. Failing that, I will have to escalate my case to your manager. I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Tom Ruiz

Dear Ms Lee, thank you for your message. I have read your counteroffer carefully, and I understand that you cannot do both things. I am afraid I cannot accept either option as it stands, because half the price would not buy a new laptop and three weeks is too long for me. To reach a compromise, I would settle for a repair, provided that it is done by Friday 27 June. I would also be grateful if you could lend me a laptop until then, as I work from home. If that is not possible, I am willing to meet you halfway and accept a partial refund plus a free repair. Please let me know your decision by Monday, and I will consider the matter closed after the repair. Failing that, I will have to escalate the matter to your manager. I trust that we can resolve this quickly. Kind regards, Tom Ruiz
